headline: AlphaFold-based structure predictions are being stress-tested and applied to design and annotation
label: Structure Prediction Validation And Application
summary: New studies test AlphaFold models against membrane geometry, amyloid polymorphism and binder design, while pipelines annotate pathogen proteomes.
synthesis: The dominant thread is evaluating and applying predicted structures to downstream biological questions. One preprint assesses membrane compatibility of roughly 189k AlphaFold-Multimer transmembrane complexes in the AFDB, finding most have plausible bilayer geometry alongside limitations. A JCIM study reports that AlphaFold3 pseudo-ensembles capture beta-sheet organization and structural diversity in short amyloidogenic peptides. Another JCIM paper combines AlphaFold, MD, docking and SAP signatures to diagnose trade-offs between target binding and self-association in de novo SARS-CoV-2 RBD binders. Two preprints apply bioinformatic and immunoinformatic pipelines to Nipah virus vaccine design and to Rickettsia akari hypothetical protein annotation. What is new is the emphasis on benchmarking prediction plausibility and failure modes against physical or experimental criteria, rather than accepting models at face value.
